notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 5 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {5}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {U} due to Will's ability.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse, causing you to draw a card and return it to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {U}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
